name: Published bZx pool reserves with hypothetical lender
description: Only the starting sUSD/ETH reserves and the 540 ETH pool input come from the published bZx analysis. The lender, collateral, loan-to-value ratio, fee, and cash cap are hypothetical. This is not a transaction replay or historical profit estimate.
